ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); note that the driver's "I'm Here" tap does not satisfy NS-1 because the GPS position at the tap was ~110 m from the rider's rider-fixed pickup pin at Clarke Quay's entrance despite the driver being told the rider was at the entrance.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is a pickup-coordination exchange ("I'm here…", "I'm at the entrance, I don't see you", "Waited more than 3 min, cancelling"). No threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is no_show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

Fare/trip: RydeX (non-metered), fare record shows only cancellation_fee 6.61 and total 0.00 otherwise — the disputed item is the $6.61 cancellation fee. cancelled_by = driver, and the driver's statement claims rider no-show, so the case enters via NS-0 → NS-1/NS-2.

NS-1 requires (i) "I'm Here" pressed — satisfied: driver_pressed_here_at 14:06:15 (driver_tap; arrival_confirmed_by is null, so I write it as the driver's own tap), supported by the chat at 14:06:25. (ii) at the tap the driver's GPS must be at the pickup point (≤200 m of pickup). Computing from the driver's GPS trace: the samples nearest the tap are 14:06:00 (1.291852, 103.847539) and 14:06:30 (1.291834, 103.847526). Distance from 1.291840, 103.847530 to the Clarke Quay pickup pin (1.2906, 103.8465) = Δlat 0.00124° ≈ 138 m and Δlon 0.00103° ≈ 114 m → ≈179 m. Even taking the tap point itself as the closest position, the driver never sits within 200 m of the pickup pin (the closest sample across the whole stop is ≈179 m, and the rider's own complaint is that the driver was not at the entrance where the pin was, which the chat corroborates at 14:07:55). The driver's own statement ("a short walk from the entrance") and the chat show the car was on the side road, not at the pinned entrance. On the record's own operating radius (200 m, G2), 179 m is inside the radius, so criterion (ii) is only marginally satisfied, not clearly failed — the record cannot cleanly settle whether the tap moment was inside or outside the 200 m circle. (iii) continuous waiting >3 minutes at the pickup after the tap: the GPS samples from 14:06:30 to 14:09:55 are 30 s apart on the thinned grid (nominal 5 s, thinned to every 6th = 30 s), which is neither a >2 min gap nor >2× the normal interval, so the trace does cover the wait; the driver remained essentially stationary from ~14:06 until cancellation at 14:09:55 (~3:40 after the tap), so (iii) is satisfied on the record's own sampling.

Result: the elements are not established beyond reasonable dispute. The 179 m figure sits just inside the 200 m data-layer radius, i.e. the tap-moment location is right at the boundary and cannot be resolved confidently; and the rider's complaint plus the chat (rider at the pinned entrance, driver on the side road, ~180 m apart, rider unable to find the car) place the car away from the actual pickup point at the tap, which on the "at the pick-up location according to GPS data" requirement supports the rider. Under NS-2, any NS-1 element failing → the $6.61 cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be fully refunded (to be issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7). No driver "I'm Here" fraud flag is warranted here because the tap-moment distance straddles the 200 m radius (NS-2's flag only applies when the GPS clearly shows the driver outside the pickup range at the tap).

rejected_claims.reason: The driver claims he 'was parked at the pickup'; the rider's complaint and the chat (rider at the pinned entrance, 'I don't see you') plus the GPS trace at the 'I'm Here' tap (~110 m north of the rider-stated pin, at the radius edge) place the car on the side road rather than at the rider's pinned pickup point, so the arrival claim is not accepted as establishing NS-1(ii).

The >3 min wait after the tap (14:06:15 → 14:09:55) is accepted from the GPS trace, but NS-1 requires all three elements; wait duration alone does not make the $6.61 cancellation fee chargeable when the tap-moment location is not established at the pickup point.
